BiblicalUsage: What is left over is the rest. Daniel asks mercy so that he and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon, and he seeks to know the truth of the fourth beast and the rest of it. In Ezra the word is administrative: the rest of the king's companions, and whatever more is needful for the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the remnant idea runs through this word even in its plain uses. God leaves a rest, and the rest is where His work goes on.
